mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) combined with tadalafil (phosphodiesterase-5 inhibitor) can cause severe hypotension through potentiation of vasodilatory effects and potential serotonergic interactions.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if tadalafil is essential, use lowest dose with close blood pressure monitoring, ensure adequate washout of MAOI (14 days), and consider alternative ED agents or switching to non-MAOI antidepressants.
